paper_title: Probiotics intervention in preventing conversion of impaired glucose tolerance to diabetes: The PPDP follow-on study

pico.outcome: investigate the incidence of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) after 6 years in patients with IGT who received early probiotic intervention in the Probiotics Prevention Diabetes Program (PPDP) trial

supplement: inetervention_period_day changes the unit from years to days.
